exceptions.justification: Genuinely used by every gh-API-backed evaluator in scripts/openssf-scorecard/github-checks.ts (Branch-Protection, Code-Review, Signed-Releases, Contributors, Maintained) and by run.ts's own repo-metadata lookup -- but those callers are reachable only by being imported by scripts/openssf-scorecard/run.ts, itself reachable solely by being spawned via `tsx` from checks/openssf-scorecard.ts's `run: [...]`, so knip's static import graph never resolves the use. gh-api.ts's own `packageVersion`/`ghApiRaw` are now imported directly and statically by checks/openssf-scorecard.ts (for provenance metadata and the live weight-table fetch), which is what makes gh-api.ts itself, `GhApiResult`, and `yaml` (transitively, via weights.ts) newly visible to knip -- `ghApiJson`/`repoSlug` specifically are not among those statically-reachable exports, the same reachability gap as every other spawned-only file in this directory.
exceptions.name: ghApiJson

exceptions.justification: Genuinely used by scripts/openssf-scorecard/run.ts (to build the `owner/repo` slug every sub-check queries) -- but run.ts is reachable only by being spawned via `tsx` from checks/openssf-scorecard.ts's `run: [...]`, so knip's static import graph never resolves the use. See the neighboring `ghApiJson` entry above for why this export specifically (as opposed to gh-api.ts's other exports) is still flagged even though the file itself is no longer `unused-file`.
